title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: next best actions from Customer Intent Agent in the Copilot pane
notes: claim 64: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft documents administrator enablement, experience-profile selection, the Dataverse update operations and the pay-as-you-go prerequisite.
